accuracy: The persona debate got 45% exactly right vs 50% for a single agent (n = 20; wide intervals).
critical_miss: A single agent called 11% of critical patients non-urgent; with the debate, 11% slipped through without a nurse seeing them.
coverage: At the default setting the debate sends 30% of cases to a nurse and is right on 50% of the rest.
auroc: Agent disagreement flags errors better than a single agent's own confidence (AUROC 0.61 vs 0.50).
cost: The debate costs 4.0 calls and 3,290 tokens per patient, about 5.3x a single agent.
fairness: Swapping only the patient's sex changed the decision in 1 of 14 cases for a single agent and 4 of 14 for the debate.
